title: Huntington, WV — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Huntington, WV: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Huntington is a city in WV with a population of 46,000. Home of Marshall University with the Ritter Park and a historic downtown. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. The population skews young, with a median age of 34.9.
